note: Reviewed against the CPSC recall text (saferproducts.gov recall API and the local cards.json). Every listing photo was downloaded and viewed, including the ones marked no. 'yes' means the listing is the whole product of the recalled product line, even when the listed unit is a later generation or a model number outside the recall. Three groups rest on a line-definition judgment and are easy to re-score if a narrower definition is wanted: Baby Jogger City Mini GT2/GT3 (all-terrain variants of the City Mini line, scored yes), Jool Baby Nova Signature and Nova Nature (variants of the Nova swing, scored yes), and the Graco Day2Dream playards and Dream On Me Lacy bassinets (scored unclear). Parts, accessories, and listings matched only on a shared word are scored no.
